links.description: The specific symbolic intent (energy, focus, streaks/momentum, power) behind choosing a lightning bolt for a 'discipline' themed app is not explicitly documented; flagged for review.

As the favicon file for this repository (named 'discipline'), the icon serves as the visual brand/tab identity for the app; the lightning bolt likely symbolizes energy, speed, motivation, or willpower fitting a discipline/productivity app.

Small square favicon: a dark navy/indigo-purple rounded-square background with a centered white/light lightning bolt (thunderbolt) glyph. The bolt is rendered in a simplified, angular, flat-icon style typical of app favicons. Visually it conveys energy, speed, power, or a jolt of action/motivation, fitting a productivity or discipline/habit-tracking app theme (repo name 'discipline') where the bolt could symbolize willpower, momentum, or quick action.

The favicon is a small square icon with a dark navy/indigo background and a white-to-light-purple gradient lightning bolt (thunderbolt) shape centered on it, rendered with rounded corners typical of an app icon.
